parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO workflow_errors (
  workflow_name,
  execution_id,
  error_message,
  error_stack,
  failed_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ String($json.workflow_name).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.execution_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.error_message).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.error_stack ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.failed_at }}'
);
